negative_reviews.author: Ellie Bleasdale
negative_reviews.text:
Today was my 5th visit to Maki & Ramen in Leeds, having previously really enjoyed the food and brought along different friends and family on each occasion. My only previous criticism would have been how close together the tables are. Unfortunately, tonight’s experience has completely changed my opinion.

The service was extremely disappointing. We waited 15 minutes to be approached, so ended up ordering through the QR code on the table. After receiving our drinks and sharing some sushi, we waited around 35–40 minutes for our ramen. During this time, two tables who arrived after us had already received the exact same dishes. We were never asked if we wanted to order another drink either.

When we eventually asked about our order, we were told the ticket hadn’t gone through to the kitchen and asked to show our email receipt. There was no apology, and nobody had checked whether we were enjoying our starter or offered us another drink while we waited. We then waited a further 15 minutes for our food.

Having ordered the same ramen on all five visits, I was really disappointed with it. The broth was nowhere near as good as previously, and by this point the long wait and poor service had completely put me off. The only positive was that the karaage chicken was still as good as ever.

To finish things off, when we asked to take the remaining food home, we were simply handed two containers to decant the ramen into ourselves.

It’s such a shame that a restaurant I’ve previously enjoyed and recommended has left me feeling this way. Unfortunately, I won’t be returning or recommending it going forward. There are plenty of other places in Leeds serving great ramen, and the service tonight has completely put me off coming back. Unfortunately, due to us paying online we had already paid the full amount otherwise we’d have probably asked for the bill & left after the sushi. Then to finish the visit no one asked if we had enjoyed the food , apologised before we left or even said bye thanks for coming as any other restaurant would.

negative_reviews.author: Phoebe Chen
negative_reviews.text:
The servers are friendly enough and I can see they aren’t slacking at all, but management is clearly a little disorganised beginning from when you are sat down to the order and timing of the food being brought out.

We ordered 2 ramens (tonkostu ramen & steak ramen) and 1 green dragon roll which came to £55. Not much to complain about the sushi it was quite nice, but the ramen is another story. The broth was thick, heavy and oily which is basically the complete opposite of what good ramen is meant to be (light & clean). There was something off with the noodles it seemed to have a weird texture and was chewy. Perhaps it was boiled for too long? Needless to say, we didn’t finish the ramen at all and still spent £55. In the photo attached you can see the layer of oil. Maybe this restaurant is more suited to British tastes, very clearly not targeted for actual Asian palettes.
